task.title: Bound global task inventory work in mutations and reads
task.description:
Several normal paths still materialize or refresh the entire active task set: create computes a rank from Reader.List, move scans a status/priority bucket, depend loads the graph for cycle detection, prefix resolution refreshes the namespace, list projects every task/label/dependency, and the web board polls the full collection. At 500 tasks the current system remains usable, but these paths are structurally O(tasks) and are the next likely local scaling limit once the corrected hot-cache benchmark is in place.

Add task-count slope measurements to the corrected harness, attribute projection query and Git-ref refresh costs, then replace broad List-based planning with narrow projection queries or explicit inventory operations where correctness allows. Preserve exact rational ordering, cycle rejection, prefix ambiguity, projection repair, task visibility, and Git-backed canonical writes. Do not introduce a required daemon or make SQLite canonical.

Acceptance: create, move, depend, prefix resolution, and unchanged board/list reads have bounded Git command shape; targeted queries return the same results as the existing full-list implementation across tombstones, labels, dependencies, and concurrent projection refreshes; and 100/500/1,000-task evidence shows the remaining scaling slope and trade-offs.
